description: The House Democratic Caucus is currently seeking candidates for a full or part-time Policy Fellowship, with positions available starting immediately. Fellows will report to the Policy Director and specialize in applicable policy areas. Fellows will track legislation, perform legislative research, and assist the Policy Director as needed. Applicants should possess excellent research skills, the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment, and advanced writing skills. Ideal candidates will either be enrolled in or have completed a Master's program or law program with good standing. Ideal candidates will also have political experience (in a legislative office or otherwise) and/or a strong history of performing legislative research. Capitol Hill experience is preferred, but not required. Interested applicants should send a resume, cover letter, and two writing samples to DemCaucus.Fellowship@mail.house.gov with applicant name and "Policy Fellowship" in the subject line no later than Friday, February 22th at 5:00pm. In cover letter, please include availability and policy areas of expertise. Applicants must be willing to work through May 2019 (with possibility of extension) and should be within commuting distance from Capitol Hill. Please no phone calls or drop-ins. Women and minority candidates are particularly encouraged to apply. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, disability or age.
